title: Great Storage!
text: Great Storage!. My daughter just moved into a small apartment. There's no storage in the bathroom, so she has hung this up on the back of the door. It stays in place well. In fact, much better than the organizers that just hang over the door. There's plenty of room for her and her roommate to keep their stuff in.

product_metadata.title: Over The Door Hanging Organizer Storage Wall Mount Premium Durable with 7 Unique Large Pockets Customizable Metal Door Hooks 17” Wide * 73” Long Closet Organizer Office Home Easy to Setup Ivory
features: Full length 2" wide hook and loop straps are soft, durable and very strong.Strong elastic at the bottom of both straps to stretch for a perfect fit of most doors.

Each attachment can support up to 10 pounds of product.Total over the door organizer with all 7 attachments can hold up to 70lbs.No tool assembly or attachment.Simple hooks at the top and bottom of your door make for easy installation.

Customizable! The 7 unique attachments are designed to be placed in any sequence that you want.Keep items you want out of reach from children and pets higher. Also enjoy removing your filled attachment from the door to your work station when you are done, replacing it.
Over the door organizer will not scratch or damage your wood or painted interior door.It will stay in one place and never shift once in place when you open or close the door.
OTD organizer hangs over the door for simple storage accessories belts, ties, scarves, glasses, watches, jewelry,shoes and easy access
